# Bug report

## Problem

Describe the incorrect behavior and affected file or revision.

## Reproduction

Provide sanitized steps, commands and observed output.

## Expected behavior

Describe the correct outcome and relevant environment.

## Checks

- [ ] I searched existing issues.
- [ ] I included no secrets or private data.
- [ ] I distinguished proposed functionality from implemented behavior.

For sensitive vulnerabilities, follow [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md).
